literal: Both enmity and friendship the eye will reveal, if one finds those who understand the variations of the eye.
translation: Both enmity and friendship will be revealed by the eyes, if one can find those who are skilled at reading the varying expressions of the eye.
modern: கண்ணின் வேறுபட்ட குறிப்புகளைப் புரிந்து கொள்ளக்கூடியவர்களைப் பெற்றால், ஒருவருடைய பகைமையையும் நட்பையும் அவருடைய கண்களே காட்டிவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how the eyes serve as a powerful medium of unspoken communication. It asserts that both hostility (பகைமை) and friendship (கேண்மை) are clearly expressed through a person's eyes. However, this silent message can only be understood if one finds observers who are capable of reading the subtle variations (வகைமை) in eye expressions. The eyes act as a mirror to the inner mind, but they require a perceptive reader to decode their true meaning.
